id: title:Gilbert09:recognize revoked token wording under generic 40000 code

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a named constant and test coverage for TikTok Ads API token revocation errors, improving OAuth account listing reliability and distinguishing credential failures from transient errors.
review.reason: Adds a named constant and test coverage for TikTok Ads API token revocation errors, improving OAuth account listing reliability and distinguishing credential failures from transient errors.
review.uncertainty: This score relies on the assumption that the supplied observations represent the complete, relevant implementation and test coverage for this TikTok-specific OAuth error handling. No independent verification of production behavior or actual incident avoidance is available. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation and test addition, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new constant TIKTOK_INVALID_TOKEN_MESSAGE with the value "Access token is incorrect or has been revoked".
observations.code_quote: TIKTOK_INVALID_TOKEN_MESSAGE = "Access token is incorrect or has been revoked"
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a named constant for a specific TikTok Ads API error message, replacing reliance on string literals or the generic 40000 bucket alone.

observations.behavior: Updates the OAuth account listing error handling to recognize the new invalid token message alongside the existing app token mismatch message, both under the generic 40000 API code.
observations.code_quote: and (TIKTOK_APP_TOKEN_MISMATCH_MESSAGE in str(e) or TIKTOK_INVALID_TOKEN_MESSAGE in str(e))
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the backend to distinguish between an app token mismatch and a revoked/invalid token, both requiring a credential reconnection rather than a transient retry, while sharing the same generic API code 40000.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case entry for the "revoked_token" scenario with the corresponding message and API code.
observations.code_quote: ("revoked_token", 40000, "Access token is incorrect or has been revoked."),
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test to verify that the OAuth account listing correctly maps the revoked token error to the expected reconnect message, preventing the error from escaping as an unhandled transient failure.
